label: Intellectual PURE_ACT_5 beings operate, from intellect as an exercised capacity
meaning: Let x be in potency in no respect and have intellect. Its intellect is a capacity to understand (first premise). That capacity is exercised or a potency to understanding (second premise); x is in potency in no respect, so not in potency to understanding, and so it is actually understanding. Whatever is POTENCY_3 capable of understanding and IN_ACT_3 understanding has an immanent operation (third premise), so x operates. No premise mentions life, time or being unmoved; the act and potency predicates are the same throughout (one respect, one InAct, one InPotency); the passage from capacity (POTENCY_3) to the potency of pure act (POTENCY_2) is the listed sense bridge, the second premise. Conditional consequence; all three premises stay open.
